callout.text: Morning refresh 26 Nov 2026 ~6:35 AM HKT: Correction on Megas — Twilight Wishes Mega Beedrill, Houndoom, Sableye, and Manectric are still LIVE worldwide through Mon 30 Nov 8:00 PM local. Official Twilight Wishes and Leek Duck’s current raid-bosses list (which already rotated 5★ from Cresselia + Darkrai to all four Deoxys formes) still list those four event Megas, not Mega Metagross. Last evening’s refresh had treated Metagross as live from Wed 25 Nov 6:00 AM local based on the Leek Duck Mega Metagross event page and GO Hub this-week / November mega schedule; that handoff is not confirmed in gyms, so Metagross is no longer marked live. Deoxys (Normal / Attack / Defense / Speed) 5★ is now LIVE worldwide, including Alaska, Hawaii, and remaining far-western time zones, through Tue 1 Dec 10:00 PM local (Leek Duck Deoxys event page + GO Hub this-week). Hundos: Normal 1806 / 2257 Windy, Attack 1474 / 1842, Defense 1299 / 1624, Speed 1645 / 2056; all shiny-eligible. Deoxys Raid Hour (Wed 25 Nov 6:00–7:00 PM local) has ENDED in Asia, Oceania, the Middle East, Europe, and Africa after 7:00 PM local; still later this morning and today in the Americas (US East starting shortly after this check, then westward through Hawaii early afternoon HKT). Twilight Wishes 1★/3★ (crown Pikachu, scarf Espeon/Umbreon; all shiny-eligible) stay LIVE worldwide through Mon 30 Nov 8:00 PM local. Shadow 1★ Larvitar/Mudkip/Makuhita/Cranidos + Shadow 3★ Prinplup/Piloswine/Poliwhirl still current; Shadow Tornadus 5★ weekends only, next Sat 28–Sun 29. Eggs unchanged (Leek Duck Updated Sep 14; no Twilight Wishes event egg override published). Rocket unchanged (Leek Duck Updated Oct 2; Giovanni inactive).
